risk_note: RV2 (funds). adminCreatePayoutBatch and adminGetPayoutOverview are implemented (BR-WDR-11, 12, 18; D10-595). After the review a withdrawal had no way to be paid with the automatic switch off: this is the entry that moves it APPROVED to PAYING. The batch is executeBatch unchanged in its decisions, kind=manual, with the audit record on one idempotent transaction; a refused batch is a stored 200 with an audit record, and a non-UUID id never reaches the database. No voucher: the money stays frozen until the result (BR-WDR-09); the payout process reviews each withdrawal again before sending. The overview is read only on one snapshot. payout-execute.ts only exports its setting reader and parsers, and watermark.ts adds readChannelWaterLevel with readAlipayWaterLevel delegating to it, so the page uses the same keys and defaults as EXECUTE. readDailySentFen is a second copy of transfer-job's dailySentFen because jobs/ is outside this ledger's paths; the two match today and no test compares them. Reported, not changed: a withdrawal never on a batch keeps batch_id null when first left, so a later execute writes no moved_out; the contract says so, and BR-WDR-12's example reads differently (no money or status effect). No migration: the column grants were checked for #2308. The console has no buttons yet (fe).
